detector._note: Keypoints 11-13-15 / 12-14-16 (shoulder-elbow-wrist), 3D world angle. A rep closes to 80: BOTTOM at <=85, 80 is full depth. topEnter stays 170 as the depth reference, which is deliberately more generous than the arm actually reaches.

stage._note: angle(11,13,15) and angle(12,14,16), 800 ms apart, either arm. Measured on the phone 5 Sep 2026 and confirmed by the player on 6 Sep: an extended arm reads 150-159 on the 3D world landmarks, never the 170 a diagram promises, because the forearm is edge-on and depth is the noisiest axis; a real curl closes to 55-78. So >135 arms and <80 counts. The picker's reference animation closes only to 85, which this deliberately does not count: the mode says half reps do not count, and 93 would have counted them. Ceiling 25: An elbow reading under 25 is past the range the forearm has against the biceps; below that it is tracking error, not a deeper curl. The rep still lands the moment it crosses the counting line; the ceiling only refuses a reading the joint cannot actually produce, which is the only sense a ceiling can have when the rep is over at the crossing. armLine 35: the upper arm must be within 35 degrees of the torso AT THE COUNTING FRAME, judged there rather than accumulated over the rep. MEASURED on the player 6 Sep 2026 from a 65 s logcat capture of reps he called correct: at the counting frame a good curl reads 3.9-22.1 degrees off the torso, but somewhere earlier in the same rep the reading spikes as far as 48, so an any-frame rule threw away 4 good reps in 14 on one noisy frame. minConcentricMs 120: the lift, rest to the counting line, must take 120 ms. MEASURED in the same capture: his own reps take 159-262 ms over that segment, so the gate sits just below the fastest thing a real curl did. It is a modest gate at his tempo - it refuses a throw, not a brisk rep. Both replaced provisional guesses of 30 and 500 ms, which together refused all 14 reps he performed: 10 died on tempo, 4 on the any-frame arm line. There is deliberately NO grip guard - telling a supinated curl from a hammer curl needs landmarks 17-22, which the model reports at 0.3-0.7 confidence and drops exactly when the forearm occludes them, and Condition.holds() passes NaN, so such a guard would silently never fire.

tempo._note: measured window: topExit crossing -> bottomEnter crossing, not the full descent

cues.enter: Face the camera, arms hanging straight down, elbows tucked to your sides.
cues.tooHigh: Curl all the way up — elbow closed to 80° or less.
cues.tooFast: Slow the curl and squeeze at the top.
cues.gate: Pin your elbow to your side and take a full second lifting — swinging it up doesn't count.
cues.framing: I can't see your elbows — step back.
